author: "Kate Matlin"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true

  geneset: "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5"
  # Plot labels for the gene set. Thresholds are those in code/generate_signatures.Rmd
  # (te_padj < 0.05, te_lfc > 0.5); set both when changing `geneset`.
  set_context: "1 hr hypoxia"
  set_definition: "TE padj < 0.05, TE LFC > 0.5"

---

Ranks amino acids by how far a gene set's synonymous codon choice departs from the
**rest of the transcriptome**, with no negative-control set. MDA-MB-231: transcripts
and isoforms are those of the 231 feature matrix.

**Comparator.** Every transcript in the feature matrix that is *not* in the gene set.
The expected usage of codon j within amino acid AA is the mean per-transcript fraction
of AA's codons that are j across those transcripts - the transcriptome-corrected RSCU
(bg-RSCU) background of notebook 38, minus the gene set. A gene set's mean bg-RSCU
for codon j is exactly `p_set_j / p_bg_j`.

**Per-amino-acid effect size.** Total variation distance (TVD) between the set's and
the background's within-family proportions:

TVD_AA = 0.5 * sum_j |p_set_j - p_bg_j| = 0.5 * sum_j p_bg_j * |bgRSCU_j - 1|

It is the fraction of AA's codons that would have to switch synonym to make the set
look like the background, in [0, 1] for every family size.

**Floors.** TVD has a noise floor that is higher for larger families and rarer amino
acids, so each amino acid is scored against its own: `n_draws` comparison sets the
same size as the gene set. Two rules make the gene set and its comparison sets
exchangeable, and the calibration in Section 5 fails if either is broken:

1. **Every set is scored against everything except itself.** The gene set against the
   rest of the transcriptome, and each comparison set against the transcriptome minus
   that set (gene set included). Leaving a comparison set inside its own background
   shrinks every floor by ~n_set / n (16% here): 12.8% false positives instead of 5%.
2. **Comparison sets are drawn from the whole transcriptome, gene set included.** A
   1,420-transcript AT-rich gene set holds a large share of all AT-rich transcripts;
   drawing GC3-matched sets only from what is left forces them onto the same few
   leftover transcripts, so the floor is too narrow (9-12% false positives on AT-skewed
   fakes, whatever the matching method). Under the null the gene set *is* a random set
   with its GC3, so it belongs in the population it is compared with.

- **random** - any transcripts. Does this amino acid's codon choice differ from a
  typical mRNA's?
- **GC3-matched** - stratified on GC3 (GC at synonymous third positions): the
  transcriptome is cut into `n_gc3_bins` equal-count GC3 bins and each draw takes as
  many transcripts from each bin as the gene set has there, sampled from the *whole*
  bin. Does it differ *beyond what the genes' GC3 predicts*? Bins have to be fine
  (10 bins left the gene set at the AT-rich end of each bin); nearest-neighbour
  matching was tried instead and fails calibration, because it restricts every draw
  to the same small set of neighbours. 100 bins: 4.8% false positives on AT-skewed
  fakes.

z = (observed - null mean) / null sd; empirical p = (k + 1) / (n + 1), so the floor
is 1 / (n_draws + 1), not 0. BH across the 18 multi-codon amino acids.

**Calibration (Section 5)** runs the whole procedure on fake gene sets with no codon
selection, including ones given the gene set's AT-skew, and checks that the
GC3-matched floor calls ~5% of them significant.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params)) {
  params <- list(geneset = "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5",
                 set_context = "1 hr hypoxia", set_definition = "TE padj < 0.05, TE LFC > 0.5",
                 n_draws = 1000,
                 n_gc3_bins = 100, n_cal = 30, n_cal_draws = 100)
}
```

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)
library(coRdon)
library(Matrix)
```

# Section 1: CDS sequences and codon counts

Same transcript universe and CDS extraction as notebook 38, plus one extra mask:
transcripts with no terminal stop codon (GENCODE `cds_end_NF`, truncated CDS) are
dropped, since in-frame truncated CDSs pass the `%% 3` filter but are incomplete.

```{r load_data}
feature_matrix <- readRDS(
  here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds")
)
keep_tx <- feature_matrix$transcript_id_clean

txdb   <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

cds_all         <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)
cds_seqs_all    <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, cds_all)
cds_names_clean <- sub("\\..*", "", names(cds_seqs_all))

keep_idx <- cds_names_clean %in% keep_tx
cds      <- cds_seqs_all[keep_idx]
names(cds) <- cds_names_clean[keep_idx]

n_start  <- length(cds)
in_frame <- width(cds) %% 3 == 0
cds      <- cds[in_frame]
last3    <- as.character(subseq(cds, start = width(cds) - 2))
has_stop <- last3 %in% c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")
cds      <- cds[has_stop]

cat("Transcripts in feature matrix with a CDS:", n_start, "\n")
cat("  dropped, not divisible by 3:", sum(!in_frame), "\n")
cat("  dropped, in frame but no terminal stop:", sum(!has_stop), "\n")
cat("  kept:", length(cds), "\n")
stopifnot("duplicate transcript IDs in CDS set" = !anyDuplicated(names(cds)))
```

```{r codon_counts}
counts_mat <- codonCounts(codonTable(cds))
rownames(counts_mat) <- names(cds)   # coRdon drops names

gen_code     <- Biostrings::getGeneticCode("SGC0")
sense_codons <- names(gen_code[gen_code != "*"])
aa_to_codons <- split(sense_codons, gen_code[sense_codons])
multi_aa     <- names(aa_to_codons)[lengths(aa_to_codons) > 1]

aa_three_letter <- c(
  A = "Ala", C = "Cys", D = "Asp", E = "Glu", F = "Phe",
  G = "Gly", H = "His", I = "Ile", K = "Lys", L = "Leu",
  M = "Met", N = "Asn", P = "Pro", Q = "Gln", R = "Arg",
  S = "Ser", T = "Thr", V = "Val", W = "Trp", Y = "Tyr"
)
aa_full_name <- c(
  A = "Alanine", C = "Cysteine", D = "Aspartic acid", E = "Glutamic acid",
  F = "Phenylalanine", G = "Glycine", H = "Histidine", I = "Isoleucine",
  K = "Lysine", L = "Leucine", M = "Methionine", N = "Asparagine",
  P = "Proline", Q = "Glutamine", R = "Arginine", S = "Serine",
  T = "Threonine", V = "Valine", W = "Tryptophan", Y = "Tyrosine"
)

stopifnot(
  "expected 18 multi-codon amino acids" = length(multi_aa) == 18,
  "codon columns missing" = all(sense_codons %in% colnames(counts_mat)),
  "rownames lost" = identical(rownames(counts_mat), names(cds))
)
```

# Section 2: Gene set

```{r gene_set}
geneset_path <- here("output", "genesets", paste0(params$geneset, ".csv"))
stopifnot("gene set CSV not found" = file.exists(geneset_path))
set_genes <- read_csv(geneset_path, show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene

tx_gene <- feature_matrix %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean,
            ensembl_gene = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>%
  filter(transcript_id_clean %in% rownames(counts_mat))

set_tx   <- tx_gene$transcript_id_clean[tx_gene$ensembl_gene %in% set_genes]
is_set   <- rownames(counts_mat) %in% set_tx
set_idx  <- which(is_set)
pool_idx <- which(!is_set)          # the gene set's background
univ_idx <- seq_len(nrow(counts_mat)) # source of every comparison set (rule 2)
n_set    <- length(set_idx)
n_bg     <- nrow(counts_mat)

# Factor label and colour follow the gene set, so an si3e run is not drawn as eIF3d
kd_factor <- if (grepl("_3e_", params$geneset)) "eIF3e" else "eIF3d"
set_col   <- c(eIF3d = "#E69F00", eIF3e = "#56B4E9")[[kd_factor]]

cat("Gene set:", params$geneset, "(", kd_factor, ")\n")
cat("  genes in CSV:", length(set_genes), "| transcripts in CDS universe:", n_set, "\n")
cat("  background (rest of transcriptome):", length(pool_idx), "transcripts\n")
stopifnot("gene set has too few transcripts" = n_set >= 50,
          "one transcript per gene expected" =
            !anyDuplicated(tx_gene$ensembl_gene[tx_gene$transcript_id_clean %in% set_tx]),
          "gene set and background overlap" = !any(set_idx %in% pool_idx))
```

---

# Section 3: Within-family proportions, background and GC3

For each amino acid, a transcripts x codons matrix of within-family proportions. A
transcript with no codons for that amino acid is NA for it and is left out of every
mean, as in notebook 38.

```{r proportions}
prop_list <- map(set_names(multi_aa), function(aa) {
  cnt <- counts_mat[, aa_to_codons[[aa]], drop = FALSE]
  tot <- rowSums(cnt)
  p   <- cnt / tot
  p[tot == 0, ] <- NA
  p
})

# Background from a set of rows (reused for the calibration fakes)
bg_from <- function(rows) map(prop_list, ~ colMeans(.x[rows, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
bg_props <- bg_from(pool_idx)

stopifnot(
  "background proportions do not sum to 1" =
    all(abs(map_dbl(bg_props, sum) - 1) < 1e-9),
  "background proportion outside [0, 1]" =
    all(unlist(bg_props) >= 0 & unlist(bg_props) <= 1)
)

# Biological spot-check on the background
leu <- bg_props[["L"]]
stopifnot("CTG should be the most-used Leu codon in human mRNA" =
            names(leu)[which.max(leu)] == "CTG")
cat("Leu background proportions:", paste(names(leu), round(leu, 3), collapse = "  "), "\n")
```

```{r gc3}
# GC3 at synonymous third positions only (multi-codon amino acids), so Met/Trp and
# stop do not enter.
syn_codons <- unlist(aa_to_codons[multi_aa])
gc_end     <- syn_codons[substr(syn_codons, 3, 3) %in% c("G", "C")]
gc3_syn    <- 100 * rowSums(counts_mat[, gc_end]) / rowSums(counts_mat[, syn_codons])

stopifnot("GC3 outside [0, 100]" = all(gc3_syn >= 0 & gc3_syn <= 100, na.rm = TRUE),
          "GC3 median outside [40, 65]" = between(median(gc3_syn), 40, 65))
cat("Synonymous-site GC3 median: background", round(median(gc3_syn[pool_idx]), 1),
    "| gene set", round(median(gc3_syn[set_idx]), 1), "\n")
```

---

# Section 4: Observed TVD and the two floors

Set means are computed for all draws at once: each floor is an indicator matrix
(transcripts x draws), and a set's mean proportion is `t(P) %*% W / t(valid) %*% W`
with NAs zeroed.

```{r tvd_engine}
# Mean within-family proportions for many sets at once.
# W: sparse 0/1 matrix, transcripts x sets. Returns list (per AA) of codons x sets.
set_means <- function(W) {
  map(prop_list, function(p) {
    valid <- !is.na(p[, 1])
    p0    <- p; p0[!valid, ] <- 0
    num   <- as.matrix(crossprod(p0, W))
    den   <- as.numeric(crossprod(as.numeric(valid), W))
    sweep(num, 2, den, "/")
  })
}
# Background for each comparison set = universe minus that set (rule 1). Duplicates
# (possible only when a GC3 bin is smaller than the gene set's count there) are removed
# once from the background but weighted in the set mean.
rest_bg <- function(W, universe) {
  W@x[] <- 1
  map(prop_list, function(p) {
    valid <- !is.na(p[, 1])
    p0    <- p; p0[!valid, ] <- 0
    num   <- as.matrix(crossprod(p0, W))
    den   <- as.numeric(crossprod(as.numeric(valid), W))
    (colSums(p0[universe, , drop = FALSE]) - num) /
      matrix(sum(valid[universe]) - den, nrow(num), ncol(num), byrow = TRUE)
  })
}
# bg: per AA either a codon vector (one background) or a codons x sets matrix
tvd_from_means <- function(means, bg) {
  map(names(means), function(aa) 0.5 * colSums(abs(means[[aa]] - bg[[aa]]))) %>%
    set_names(names(means)) %>% as_tibble()
}
idx_to_W <- function(idx_list) {
  sparseMatrix(i = unlist(idx_list),
               j = rep(seq_along(idx_list), lengths(idx_list)),
               x = 1, dims = c(n_bg, length(idx_list)))
}

# GC3-stratified draws: bins = equal-count GC3 quantiles of the candidates; each draw
# takes the target set's count per bin from the whole bin (with replacement only when
# a bin is smaller than that count).
gc3_strat_draws <- function(target_idx, candidates, n_bins, n_draws) {
  br    <- unique(quantile(gc3_syn[candidates], seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)))
  b_c   <- cut(gc3_syn[candidates], br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  b_t   <- cut(gc3_syn[target_idx], br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  need  <- tabulate(b_t, max(b_c))
  pools <- split(candidates, factor(b_c, levels = seq_len(max(b_c))))
  replicate(n_draws, unlist(map2(pools, need, function(pl, k) {
    if (k == 0) integer(0) else pl[sample.int(length(pl), k, replace = k > length(pl))]
  })), simplify = FALSE)
}

# Empirical scoring of one observed TVD row against a null TVD table
score_vs <- function(obs, null_tvd) {
  map_dfr(multi_aa, function(aa) {
    nul <- null_tvd[[aa]]; o <- obs[[aa]]
    tibble(amino_acid = aa, tvd = o,
           null_median = median(nul),
           null_lo = quantile(nul, 0.05), null_hi = quantile(nul, 0.95),
           z = (o - mean(nul)) / sd(nul),
           p_emp = (sum(nul >= o) + 1) / (length(nul) + 1))
  }) %>% mutate(q = p.adjust(p_emp, "BH"))
}

obs_means <- set_means(idx_to_W(list(set_idx)))
obs_tvd   <- tvd_from_means(obs_means, bg_props)
stopifnot("TVD outside [0, 1]" = all(obs_tvd >= 0 & obs_tvd <= 1))
```

```{r null_random}
set.seed(9)
idx_random <- replicate(params$n_draws, univ_idx[sample.int(length(univ_idx), n_set)],
                        simplify = FALSE)
W_random          <- idx_to_W(idx_random)
null_random_means <- set_means(W_random)
null_random_bg    <- rest_bg(W_random, univ_idx)
null_random_tvd   <- tvd_from_means(null_random_means, null_random_bg)

# Sanity: across random draws the mean bg-RSCU of every codon is ~1 by construction
mean_bg_rscu <- unlist(map(names(null_random_means),
                           ~ rowMeans(null_random_means[[.x]] / null_random_bg[[.x]])))
stopifnot("random-null mean bg-RSCU drifts from 1" = all(abs(mean_bg_rscu - 1) < 0.01))
```

```{r null_gc3}
set.seed(9)
idx_gc3 <- gc3_strat_draws(set_idx, univ_idx, params$n_gc3_bins, params$n_draws)
stopifnot("matched draws are the wrong size" = all(lengths(idx_gc3) == n_set))
cat("Matched draws containing a repeated transcript:",
    round(mean(map_lgl(idx_gc3, ~ anyDuplicated(.x) > 0)), 3), "\n")
W_gc3          <- idx_to_W(idx_gc3)
null_gc3_means <- set_means(W_gc3)
null_gc3_bg    <- rest_bg(W_gc3, univ_idx)
null_gc3_tvd   <- tvd_from_means(null_gc3_means, null_gc3_bg)

# Matching quality across the whole distribution, not just the centre
probs   <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)
q_set   <- quantile(gc3_syn[set_idx], probs)
q_match <- rowMeans(sapply(idx_gc3, function(ix) quantile(gc3_syn[ix], probs)))
q_rand  <- rowMeans(sapply(idx_random[1:100], function(ix) quantile(gc3_syn[ix], probs)))
cat("GC3, max |quantile difference| from gene set (5th-95th pct):",
    "matched", round(max(abs(q_match - q_set)), 3),
    "| random", round(max(abs(q_rand - q_set)), 2), "points\n")
stopifnot("GC3 matching off by > 0.25 points at some quantile" =
            max(abs(q_match - q_set)) < 0.25)
```

```{r score}
aa_scores <- bind_rows(
  score_vs(obs_tvd, null_random_tvd) %>% mutate(null = "random"),
  score_vs(obs_tvd, null_gc3_tvd)    %>% mutate(null = "GC3-matched")
) %>%
  mutate(aa_label = paste0(aa_full_name[amino_acid], " (",
                           lengths(aa_to_codons)[amino_acid], " codons)"))

aa_scores %>%
  dplyr::select(null, aa_label, tvd, null_median, z, p_emp, q) %>%
  arrange(null, desc(z)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(tvd, null_median), ~ round(.x, 4)), z = round(z, 2)) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Section 5: Calibration on fake gene sets

The calibration world is the non-target transcripts, so the real gene set plays no
part. Each fake gene set is `n_set` of them, run through the **whole** procedure: its
own background (world minus the fake) and `n_cal_draws` comparison sets of each kind,
drawn from the whole world and scored against the world minus themselves. Two kinds:

- **plain** - a random sample. Both floors should call it significant ~5% of the time.
- **AT-skewed** - sampled with weight `exp(-beta * GC3)`, `beta` tuned so its median
  GC3 matches the gene set's. It has the gene set's GC3 shift and no other codon
  selection. The GC3-matched floor should still call ~5% significant; if GC3 leaks
  through the matching, or the floor is too narrow, this rate rises. The random floor should
  call most of them significant, showing that a pure GC3 shift is enough to produce
  the random-floor result.

The rate is over (fake x amino acid) tests at raw p < 0.05 (p floor 1 / (n_cal_draws + 1)).
With the defaults (30 fakes x 18 amino acids = 540 tests per row) ~27 hits are expected
at a calibrated 5%. The asserted band is 2-9%; the failed designs above ran 9-13%.

```{r calibration}
# Tune the AT-skew: fine grid, median GC3 averaged over 5 draws per beta
set.seed(9)
betas  <- seq(0, 0.1, by = 0.001)
med_at <- map_dbl(betas, function(b) {
  mean(replicate(5, median(gc3_syn[sample(pool_idx, n_set, prob = exp(-b * gc3_syn[pool_idx]))])))
})
beta <- betas[which.min(abs(med_at - median(gc3_syn[set_idx])))]
cat("AT-skew beta:", beta, "| tuned median GC3:", round(med_at[betas == beta], 2),
    "| gene set:", round(median(gc3_syn[set_idx]), 2), "\n")

world <- pool_idx
run_fake <- function(fake_idx) {
  obs_c <- tvd_from_means(set_means(idx_to_W(list(fake_idx))), bg_from(setdiff(world, fake_idx)))
  W_r <- idx_to_W(replicate(params$n_cal_draws, world[sample.int(length(world), n_set)],
                            simplify = FALSE))
  W_m <- idx_to_W(gc3_strat_draws(fake_idx, world, params$n_gc3_bins, params$n_cal_draws))
  bind_rows(
    score_vs(obs_c, tvd_from_means(set_means(W_r), rest_bg(W_r, world))) %>% mutate(null = "random"),
    score_vs(obs_c, tvd_from_means(set_means(W_m), rest_bg(W_m, world))) %>% mutate(null = "GC3-matched")
  ) %>% mutate(fake_gc3_median = median(gc3_syn[fake_idx]))
}

set.seed(9)
cal <- bind_rows(
  map_dfr(seq_len(params$n_cal), ~ run_fake(sample(pool_idx, n_set)) %>%
            mutate(fake = "plain", rep = .x)),
  map_dfr(seq_len(params$n_cal), ~ run_fake(sample(pool_idx, n_set,
                                                   prob = exp(-beta * gc3_syn[pool_idx]))) %>%
            mutate(fake = "AT-skewed", rep = .x))
)

cal_summary <- cal %>%
  group_by(fake, null) %>%
  summarise(n_tests = n(),
            frac_p05 = mean(p_emp < 0.05),
            frac_q05 = mean(q < 0.05),
            fake_gc3_median = median(fake_gc3_median), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(cal_summary, digits = 3)
cat("Gene set GC3 median for comparison:", round(median(gc3_syn[set_idx]), 1), "\n")

rate <- function(f, n) cal_summary$frac_p05[cal_summary$fake == f & cal_summary$null == n]
stopifnot(
  "random floor miscalibrated on plain fakes (outside 2-9%)" =
    between(rate("plain", "random"), 0.02, 0.09),
  "GC3-matched floor miscalibrated on plain fakes (outside 2-9%)" =
    between(rate("plain", "GC3-matched"), 0.02, 0.09),
  "GC3-matched floor miscalibrated on AT-skewed fakes (outside 2-9%)" =
    between(rate("AT-skewed", "GC3-matched"), 0.02, 0.09),
  "AT-skewed fakes did not reach the gene set's GC3"   =
    abs(median(cal$fake_gc3_median[cal$fake == "AT-skewed"]) - median(gc3_syn[set_idx])) < 1
)
```

```{r plot_calibration, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
p_cal <- cal %>%
  mutate(null = factor(null, levels = c("random", "GC3-matched"),
                       labels = c("random floor", "GC3-matched floor")),
         fake = factor(fake, levels = c("plain", "AT-skewed"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = p_emp)) +
  geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05), fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ fake + null, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Calibration: empirical p for fake gene sets with no codon selection",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d fakes x 18 amino acids per row; n = %d transcripts each; flat = calibrated",
                          params$n_cal, n_set),
       x = "Empirical p", y = "Tests") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
p_cal
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_calibration_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_cal, width = 8, height = 5)
```

# Section 6: Ranked amino acids

Grey bar = 5-95% of TVD for GC3-matched transcriptome sets of the same size (the floor);
tick = floor median; point = the gene set. The main figure is the GC3-matched floor;
the random-floor version is saved alongside.

```{r plot_ranked, fig.width=8.5, fig.height=6.5}
rand_z <- aa_scores %>% filter(null == "random")

plot_floor <- function(null_lbl, subtitle) {
  d <- aa_scores %>% filter(null == null_lbl) %>%
    mutate(aa_label = fct_reorder(aa_label, z),
           sig = if_else(q < 0.05, "BH q < 0.05", "n.s."),
           lab = sprintf("z = %.1f", z))
  ggplot(d, aes(y = aa_label)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = null_lo, xmax = null_hi), linewidth = 3, colour = "grey80") +
    geom_point(aes(x = null_median), shape = 124, size = 4, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(aes(x = tvd, shape = sig), colour = set_col, size = 2.6) +
    geom_text(aes(x = pmax(tvd, null_hi), label = lab), hjust = -0.25, size = 2.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("BH q < 0.05" = 16, "n.s." = 1), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.25))) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Synonymous codon choice in %s targets vs rest of transcriptome", kd_factor),
         subtitle = subtitle,
         x = "Fraction of the amino acid's codons that differ from background (TVD)",
         y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
}

p_rank_gc3 <- plot_floor("GC3-matched", sprintf(
  paste0("Grey = expected from GC3 alone: 5-95%% of %d transcriptome sets with the targets' GC3 distribution.\n",
         "n = %d targets vs %d rest of transcriptome. Against unmatched random sets all %d amino acids\n",
         "differ (z %.0f to %.0f, p <= %.3f), because targets' synonymous GC3 is %.1f%% vs %.1f%%.\n",
         "This panel asks what remains beyond GC3."),
  params$n_draws, n_set, length(pool_idx), nrow(rand_z), min(rand_z$z), max(rand_z$z),
  max(rand_z$p_emp), median(gc3_syn[set_idx]), median(gc3_syn[pool_idx])))
p_rank_rand <- plot_floor("random", sprintf(
  "Grey = chance alone: 5-95%% of %d random transcriptome sets.\nn = %d targets vs %d rest of transcriptome. Not adjusted for GC3.",
  params$n_draws, n_set, length(pool_idx)))

p_rank_gc3
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_aa_codon_tvd_ranked_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_rank_gc3, width = 8.5, height = 6.5)
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_aa_codon_tvd_ranked_random_floor_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_rank_rand, width = 8.5, height = 6.5)
```

# Section 7: Which codons drive each amino acid

Mean bg-RSCU of the gene set per codon (1 = background usage), with the 5-95% band
from the same floor. Panels ordered by GC3-matched z. Colour = third-position base, so
a GC3-driven shift reads as all GC-ending codons down and AT-ending up.

```{r codon_detail}
order_aa <- aa_scores %>% filter(null == "GC3-matched") %>% arrange(desc(z)) %>% pull(aa_label)

codon_detail <- function(null_means, null_bg, label) {
  map_dfr(multi_aa, function(aa) {
    bg <- bg_props[[aa]]
    nr <- null_means[[aa]] / null_bg[[aa]]   # each set relative to the rest of the pool
    tibble(amino_acid = aa, codon = names(bg),
           bg_rscu = obs_means[[aa]][, 1] / bg,
           lo = apply(nr, 1, quantile, 0.05), hi = apply(nr, 1, quantile, 0.95))
  }) %>%
    mutate(null = label,
           ending = if_else(substr(codon, 3, 3) %in% c("G", "C"), "GC-ending", "AT-ending"))
}
codon_df <- bind_rows(codon_detail(null_random_means, null_random_bg, "random"),
                      codon_detail(null_gc3_means,    null_gc3_bg,    "GC3-matched")) %>%
  left_join(aa_scores %>% dplyr::select(amino_acid, null, aa_label), by = c("amino_acid", "null")) %>%
  mutate(aa_label = factor(aa_label, levels = order_aa))

write_csv(codon_df, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                         paste0("98_codon_bg_rscu_vs_null_", params$geneset, ".csv")))
write_csv(aa_scores, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                          paste0("98_aa_tvd_scores_", params$geneset, ".csv")))
write_csv(cal, here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                    paste0("98_calibration_", params$geneset, ".csv")))
```

```{r plot_codons, fig.width=11, fig.height=9}
codon_titles <- list(
  "GC3-matched" = c(
    sprintf("Codon usage in %s targets (n = %d): what GC3 does not explain", kd_factor, n_set),
    paste0("Point = targets. Grey = where the codon would sit if targets differed only in GC3 ",
           "(5-95% of GC3-matched transcriptome sets).\nPoint outside grey = shift beyond GC3. ",
           "Dashed line = usage in the rest of the transcriptome.\nBar height = chance variation for that codon; rare codons have taller bars because bg-RSCU divides by the codon's usual frequency.")),
  "random" = c(
    sprintf("Codon usage in %s targets (n = %d) vs the rest of the transcriptome", kd_factor, n_set),
    paste0("Point = targets. Grey = 5-95% of random transcriptome sets of the same size (chance alone). ",
           "Dashed line = usage in the rest of the transcriptome.\nBar height = chance variation for that codon; rare codons have taller bars because bg-RSCU divides by the codon's usual frequency."))
)

plot_codons <- function(lbl) {
  ggplot(filter(codon_df, null == lbl), aes(x = codon, y = bg_rscu)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 3, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(aes(colour = ending), size = 2.4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("GC-ending" = "#0072B2", "AT-ending" = "#CC79A7"),
                        name = "Third position") +
    facet_wrap(~ aa_label, scales = "free_x", nrow = 3) +
    labs(title = codon_titles[[lbl]][1], subtitle = codon_titles[[lbl]][2],
         x = "Codon", y = "Mean bg-RSCU (1 = rest of transcriptome)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "top")
}
p_cod_gc3  <- plot_codons("GC3-matched"); p_cod_gc3
p_cod_rand <- plot_codons("random");      p_cod_rand
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_codon_bg_rscu_gc3_null_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_cod_gc3, width = 11, height = 9)
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_codon_bg_rscu_random_null_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_cod_rand, width = 11, height = 9)
```

## One row per amino acid, one dot per codon

The simple view: each codon's mean bg-RSCU in the gene set (1 = usage in the rest of
the transcriptome), one row per amino acid, coloured by whether the codon ends in A/U
or G/C. Rows ordered by the amino acid's TVD (how far its codon choice moves overall).
Grey band = 5-95% of random transcriptome sets of the same size, i.e. chance alone.
Not adjusted for GC3 - this shows the shift itself, not what remains beyond GC3.

```{r plot_codon_rows, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
row_order <- aa_scores %>% filter(null == "random") %>% arrange(tvd) %>% pull(aa_label)
rows_df <- codon_df %>%
  filter(null == "random") %>%
  mutate(aa_label = factor(as.character(aa_label), levels = row_order),
         ending   = factor(if_else(ending == "AT-ending", "AU-ending", "GC-ending"),
                           levels = c("AU-ending", "GC-ending")),
         codon_rna = chartr("T", "U", codon))
chance <- rows_df %>% group_by(aa_label) %>%
  summarise(lo = min(lo), hi = max(hi), .groups = "drop")

p_rows <- ggplot(rows_df, aes(x = bg_rscu, y = aa_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_linerange(data = chance, aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, y = aa_label),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 4, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = ending), size = 2.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = codon_rna, colour = ending), size = 2.6,
                           direction = "y", nudge_y = 0.32, segment.size = 0.2,
                           min.segment.length = 0.1, box.padding = 0.1,
                           show.legend = FALSE, seed = 9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("AU-ending" = "#CC79A7", "GC-ending" = "#0072B2"),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(title = sprintf("Codon usage in %s targets (%s)", kd_factor, params$set_context),
       subtitle = sprintf(paste0("Targets: %s. n = %d targets vs %d rest of transcriptome.\n",
                                 "Grey = chance alone (5-95%% of %d random sets). ",
                                 "Rows ordered by overall shift. Not adjusted for GC3."),
                          params$set_definition, n_set, length(pool_idx), params$n_draws),
       x = "Target codon usage relative to rest of transcriptome (bg-RSCU)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
p_rows
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_codon_rows_bg_rscu_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_rows, width = 9, height = 8)
```

# Section 8: Per-gene codon share against GC3

The GC3-matched comparison works on set averages. This shows the same question one
gene at a time: each gene's share of a codon within its amino acid, against its own
synonymous GC3. If targets prefer the codon beyond what GC3 predicts, the target trend
sits above (or below) the rest-of-transcriptome trend **at the same GC3**; if the
shift is GC3 alone, the two trends overlap and the targets simply sit further left.

Panels: amino acids with GC3-matched BH q < 0.05 (the top two by z if none), and
within each the codons whose target mean falls outside the GC3-matched band, at most
two, ordered by how far outside. Two-codon families show one codon, since the other is
its mirror image. Trends are GAM smooths (`s(GC3)`) with 95% bands; points are
individual genes, targets drawn on top.

```{r per_gene_select}
sel_aa <- aa_scores %>% filter(null == "GC3-matched") %>% arrange(desc(z))
sel_aa <- if (any(sel_aa$q < 0.05)) filter(sel_aa, q < 0.05) else head(sel_aa, 2)

sel_codons <- codon_df %>%
  filter(null == "GC3-matched", amino_acid %in% sel_aa$amino_acid) %>%
  mutate(outside = pmax(lo - bg_rscu, bg_rscu - hi, 0) / (hi - lo),
         n_syn = lengths(aa_to_codons)[amino_acid]) %>%
  group_by(amino_acid) %>%
  arrange(desc(outside), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter(outside > 0 | row_number() == 1) %>%          # always at least one codon per AA
  slice_head(n = 2) %>%
  filter(n_syn > 2 | row_number() == 1) %>%            # 2-codon families: one codon
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(amino_acid = factor(amino_acid, levels = sel_aa$amino_acid)) %>%
  arrange(amino_acid)
stopifnot("no codons selected for the per-gene plot" = nrow(sel_codons) > 0)
sel_codons %>% dplyr::select(amino_acid, codon, ending, bg_rscu, lo, hi) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3)

per_gene <- pmap_dfr(list(as.character(sel_codons$amino_acid), sel_codons$codon),
                     function(aa, cod) {
  tibble(row = seq_len(n_bg), share = prop_list[[aa]][, cod], gc3 = gc3_syn,
         group = if_else(is_set, paste(kd_factor, "targets"), "Rest of transcriptome"),
         panel = sprintf("%s: %s share", aa_full_name[[aa]], cod))
}) %>%
  filter(!is.na(share)) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = unique(panel)),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Rest of transcriptome", paste(kd_factor, "targets"))))

stopifnot("codon share outside [0, 1]" = all(per_gene$share >= 0 & per_gene$share <= 1))
panel_n <- per_gene %>% dplyr::count(panel, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n)
knitr::kable(panel_n)
```

```{r plot_per_gene, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
grp_cols <- setNames(c("grey50", set_col), levels(per_gene$group))
n_lab <- per_gene %>% group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(lab = sprintf("n = %d targets, %d rest",
                          sum(group != "Rest of transcriptome"), sum(group == "Rest of transcriptome")),
            .groups = "drop")

p_gene <- ggplot(per_gene, aes(x = gc3, y = share, colour = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(per_gene, group == "Rest of transcriptome"),
             size = 0.4, alpha = 0.08, shape = 16) +
  geom_point(data = filter(per_gene, group != "Rest of transcriptome"),
             size = 0.6, alpha = 0.25, shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.4, size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = sprintf("Do %s targets prefer these codons at the same GC3?", kd_factor),
       subtitle = paste0("Each point = one gene. Lines = GAM trend with 95% band. ",
                         "Gap between lines at the same GC3 = preference beyond GC3."),
       x = "Synonymous-site GC3 of the gene (%)", y = "Codon share within its amino acid") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
p_gene
ggsave(here("plots", paste0("98_per_gene_codon_share_vs_gc3_", params$geneset, ".pdf")),
       p_gene, width = max(5, 3.4 * nlevels(per_gene$panel)), height = 4)
```
